wins: Completed multi-subnet reconnaissance with masscan and targeted nmap follow-up within the allotted time, producing a prioritized host list (ep001_step04, ep001_step07).
Captured initial service fingerprints and identified an outdated web application stack for potential exploitation (ep001_step10).
fails: Failed to gain valid credentials after repeated brute-force attempts against the exposed SSH service, leading to stall in lateral movement (ep001_step15, ep001_step18).
No successful privilege escalation attempts on the discovered Linux host despite identifying sudo misconfigurations (ep001_step21).
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance executed effectively, but attack chain stalled in credential acquisition and privilege escalation, resulting in zero successful missions despite valuable service insights.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Credential brute force attempts against SSH repeatedly timed out or hit lockout without success, indicating either strong password policies or incorrect targeting.
Privilege escalation playbooks relying on sudo misconfigurations repeatedly failed to yield root shells despite multiple verification checks.

skill_cards.if_condition: When masscan identifies open ports 22 and 80 on a host
skill_cards.then_action: Run targeted nmap -sV with default scripts and additional HTTP enumeration with gobuster

skill_cards.if_condition: When SSH banner reveals OpenSSH 7.x and login prompt available
skill_cards.then_action: Use hydra with curated credential list and parallel threads to attempt lightweight password spraying

skill_cards.if_condition: When sudo -l reveals user can run specific command without password
skill_cards.then_action: Exploit sudo misconfiguration to spawn shell via python or bash -c

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in actionable reconnaissance and service enumeration phases.
